title: Textarea
description: The Textarea component is built upon the native HTML textarea element and it should be used as a child within the Form component to provide access to the Form handler functions and utilities.

props.name: validation
props.description: Overrides the native validityState error messages.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the textarea field. Strongly recommended for accessibility, ensuring a more inclusive and user-friendly experience.

props.name: helperText
props.description: A small helper text shown bellow of the input field. Recommended for additional information about the field helpful for the user.

props.name: classes
props.type: { root: string; field: string; label: string; error: string; }
props.description: Classes applied to the root, textarea, label and error elements.

metaDesc: FormFusion's Textarea component: Powerful and customizable extention of the standard HTML textarea element built to be easily used with other FormFusion components. Easy to integrate with custom react hook allowing greater form control.
